newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Seven schoolchildren die in eastern Zimbabwe.
newsitem.headline: Seven schoolchildren die in eastern Zimbabwe.

text.p: Seven schoolchildren died at the weekend when the lorry they were travelling in to a musical event overturned in eastern Zimbabwe, police reported on Monday.
A police spokesman said 55 others were seriously injured when they were thrown out of the lorry when the driver lost control while negotiating a curve. The driver suffered minor injuries.
"Seven children were killed when the lorry rolled over on a curve," the spokesman said.
This is Zimbabwe's third serious accident involving schoolchildren since August 1991 when 83 pupils were killed when their bus overturned in the eastern town of Nyanga.
Last December, 22 students drowned in Lake Chivero, about 30 kms (19 miles) out of the capital Harare when their boat capsized.
